title: Generalized EP properties of (b c) inverses
summary: In this paper, we introduce the notion of the generalized (b,c) EP inverse within the framework of a *-Banach algebra. This concept emerges as a logical extension of the weak group inverse and EP-like property, which is applicable to complex matrices and bounded linear operators in Hilbert spaces. We provide its characterizations in relation to its associated decomposition and the generalized Drazin inverse. A polar-like property for the generalized (b,c) EP inverse is presented.
